criteria_note: Scored A-F, G, X1, R1-R3 per eval/ARTIFACT_RUBRIC.md; claims checked against https://arxiv.org/html/2507.20534 (fetched text). G is deterministic in spirit; blog lint/validator were not run, so G is judged by reading the front matter and markup. Prose length excludes front matter, headings, display math, tables, images and references.

A.reason: Clean arc (problem -> MuonClip -> data -> systems -> agentic data -> RL -> infra -> results -> safety -> assessment), no H1, levels consistent. But the results sections carry stitched fragments: L355 opens mid-thought '다중 시도에서는 71.6으로 오릅니다. 독점 모델과 비교하면 양상이 다릅니다.' and L369 ends a section on a dangling lead-in '독점 모델과 비교하면 결과가 과제마다 다릅니다.' with nothing after it; L149 '남은 5.5조 토큰에서는' presupposes a first phase never stated.

B.reason: Natural 입니다 register throughout; some calques/formulaic frames: L107 '헤드 단위로 적용한 이유로, ... 줄이기 위해서라고 밝힙니다' (rewrite: '헤드 단위로 적용한 것은 다른 헤드를 과도하게 정규화하지 않기 위해서입니다'); L239 '탐지하는 역할을 합니다' (-> '따로 탐지합니다', and it repeats the previous sentence); L52 '가산적으로 커진다는 설명입니다' noun frame; L207 two consecutive '저자들은 ... 설명합니다' sentences.

C.reason: Method half flows well with explicit back-references (L72 '앞서 본 상한식', L147 tying MLA to QK-Clip). Results half has broken transitions: L357 '반대로 ... 에이전트 모드에서는 Sonnet과 차이가 다시 벌어집니다' contrasts with an agentless comparison that was never written; L363 'DeepSeek-V3-0324는 48.8, Qwen3-235B-A22B는 37.3입니다.' gives comparators without K2's own value in the paragraph; L367 '영어 전체 점수에서' never names ACEBench; L149 orphan.

D.reason: Hard parts get help exactly where needed: L49-52 logit bound before the fix, L88 why gamma^alpha * gamma^(1-alpha) gives gamma, L92 hypothetical tau=100/S=400 worked example with the MLA sqrt split, L225 RL objective worked with 2-of-4 correct responses; telecom running example carried through data synthesis, rubric and limitations (L187, L199, L433-437). Minor padding: L181 and L245 telecom asides add little.

E.reason: Tables where comparison helps (SimpleQA rephrasing L133, reward types L233, base L295, instruct L338/L377, safety L409); images described by content, not paper numbering. Deductions: empty cell for Claude Opus 4 DROP at L385 ('| 92.0 | | 79.1') instead of the source dash; no architecture table for the 384-expert/64-head design.

F.reason: All 24 checked claims supported or figure-only; no invented formulas; \mid used for conditionals. Minor: L387 '후처리 학습 이후 점수가 두 배 이상으로 올랐습니다' compares base 1-shot LiveCodeBench (26.29) with the instruct score (53.7), a cross-setting comparison the paper does not make; L399 '패배율은 세 경우 모두 약 17%' is read off a figure.

G.reason: use_math true with $$ present; description 133 chars, starts 'Kimi K2', numbers (15.5조, 320억, 65.8, 66.1) all in TL;DR; Liquid braces inside {% raw %} at L220; https arXiv link; no code fences. Not run against the blog lint.

X1.reason: Category Agentic-AI fits; tags short. 'Sparsity-Scaling-Law' (L10) names a paper contribution the post never discusses (no sparsity/expert-count section), and 'Agentic-AI' duplicates the category.

R1.reason: Deep on MuonClip (bound, global vs per-head clip, MLA components, algorithm steps, training dynamics), memory techniques, agentic synthesis, RL (objective, verifiable rewards, critic recalibration, three stabilisers) and checkpoint engine. Gaps: no sparsity scaling law / 384-expert / 64-head choice; no parallelism config or start-up; RL verifiable-reward table (L233-237) omits coding/SWE environments; results section fragmentary around L355-369.

R2.reason: Layering intuition -> formula -> worked example is done for the two hardest contributions (MuonClip L46-99, RL objective L217-225). Length is proportionate.

R3.reason: TL;DR answers the four questions with settings ('micro Pass@1 평균(Avg@4) 66.1', '에이전트 단일 시도 Pass@1 65.8%'). Closing L423-439 names the paper's own limitations (synthetic data, token over-generation, overconfident rubric) and concrete implications; opinion is marked ('이 글의 판단으로는'). Slightly strong 'K2는 현재 가장 먼저 검토할 후보' (L439).

preference.reason: Both are factually clean (no wrong numbers found). X explains the two hardest contributions, QK-Clip on MLA and the K1.5 RL objective, in full layers with worked examples, and has valid front matter; its damage is concentrated in the instruct-results prose (L355-369). Y covers more of the report (architecture/sparsity, schedule, start-up, SWE sandbox, TerminalBench, IFEval, Crescendo) but its core method sections have dropped sentences that leave orphaned references (L62, L78, L263, L268), and it has no description so it fails G and repeats a human-fixed defect. Coverage favours Y; correctness of the method explanation and publishability favour X.
